Fullscreen-default help text; upstream plan-mode example dropped
Parses uppercase --min-expiry duration units: upstream regex matches case-insensitively but the unit ternary compares lowercase only, so 30M is billed as 30 hours
First-time-setup gate compares runtime metadata against config.ts distribution constants
Fork distribution constants: package name, disabled install telemetry, changelog hint
Pauses background delivery across session switch/new/fork, closes the session-owned Background service before runtime replacement, and re-reads the settled leaf when forking
Passes the host-assigned executionRole through session-from-services creation so nested subagent sessions cannot enable background execution

Binds detached stable model-context snapshots whose prompt is replayed from the prepared transcript; invalidates stale contexts; hosts the BackgroundSession coordinator through lifecycle pauses and persistence acknowledgements, including nextTurn context retained until persistence
Static export renders tool calls as settled (isPartial false) so fork renderers with live-refresh state never arm timers in exported HTML
Re-exports stable context snapshots, editor submit/input types, and the stale-extension-context helpers
Standalone package aliases and virtual-module keys via DISTRIBUTION_PACKAGE_NAME; no monorepo workspace resolution
Exposes canonical ModelRuntime and guarded model-context snapshots through ExtensionContext; supplies no-op editor submission hooks outside TUI mode

Tool grouping/result render context with disposable row-local state, canonical ModelRuntime, stale-context helpers, stable snapshots, synchronous editor submission, cursor access and editor-scoped terminal input
Bundled coding-agent virtual module is keyed by DISTRIBUTION_PACKAGE_NAME instead of the upstream package name
Adds configurable app.list.toggle, app.backgroundTasks.* (detach, list/preview focus, kill), app.btw.* (close, cancel, scroll), and app.provider.* (/provider pane focus, entry removal) bindings
Exposes pure API-family compat validation for the bundled /provider editor and aligns models.json compatibility fields with the pinned pi-ai thinking-budget, tool-stream, and prompt-cache options
Provides the canonical ModelRuntime backing ExtensionContext.modelRuntime
Read-only ModelRuntime.getModelsPath() accessor so the bundled /provider extension edits the same models.json the runtime loads, including custom or disabled SDK paths
relative()-based path equality for context-file shadowing; startsWith/=== provably fail across drive-letter case (realpathSync keeps input case) while win32 relative() compares case-insensitively

CreateAgentSessionOptions.executionRole carries the host-assigned execution identity; subagent-role sessions reject background execution; model preparation records a reusable context prefix outside the session's request projections and shares request-option resolution with independent context consumers
Default tuiMode is fullscreen; compaction resolves reserveTokens from triggerPercent for the model's context window when no reserve is configured; keep when syncing upstream

Drops renderShell self so edits use the native chrome; fork rendering lives in renderers/edit.ts

Explore toolGroup on the definition; fork rendering (flag badges, shared path/hint) lives in renderers/grep.ts
Explore toolGroup on the definition; fork collapsed-lines hint lives in renderers/ls.ts

Prompt snippet describes the foreground/background modes supplied by the shared shell execution definition
Explore toolGroup on the definition; fork rendering (muted range colors, group-summary expand hint) lives in renderers/read.ts
Shared collapsedLinesHint helper consumed by all built-in tool renderers

Propagates toolGroup through tool wrapping and tightens generics

Trust-key identity across drive-letter case (realpathSync keeps input case, so C:/c: cwd spellings produce distinct keys for the same dir) via lowercased drive + dev:ino stat comparison; dual HOME sources for global-resource checks
Accounts the validated background-usage ledger once per task id in session totals and cost breakdown without double-counting foreground results

repositoryRoot climbs two levels instead of four because this distribution's src tree sits two levels shallower than the upstream monorepo package
Registers the distribution's canonical bundled extension set as hidden built-ins
Re-exports model-context snapshots and editor submit/input types, plus the public Background supervision, projection, text, worker-report, and completion-snapshot types

Platform-aware key labels for hints shared by native and bundled renderers
Provider-attribution wording for the telemetry setting; fullscreen-default mode description
Dot/rail chrome assembly, tool grouping (including the toolGroup field on the ToolRenderers interface), bash progress row, image-conversion race fix, and renderer-state dispose lifecycle
Quote-aware editor command parsing via cross-spawn without a shell; upstream shell:true concatenates the unquoted temp file path, so a TEMP containing spaces splits it into multiple argv entries

Tool grouping, selector description plumbing for confirmations, canonical guarded ExtensionContext for shortcuts, distribution constants for telemetry and update hints; routes Enter/follow-up through synchronous extension interception before history and queues, exposes editor cursor position, and scopes terminal listeners to editor focus
Nested color restoration in fg/bg, bundled ice-cream themes, and correct transparent/default color semantics for HTML export
Supplies TUI-only editor submission and cursor APIs as no-ops in the RPC UI context

Loads highlight.js grammars through a static top-level import; repository source policy forbids upstream's deferred dynamic import
Version checks query the npm registry instead of the upstream pi.dev API
